capabilities.output: Record {items: List<Record {id: Int, customer: String, cents: Int, status: String, note: Option<String>}>, next: Option<String>}
capabilities.description: Returns one page of orders and the cursor of the next page, if any.

sqlite.statement: INSERT INTO orders(id, customer, cents, status, note) VALUES (:id, :customer, :cents, :status, :note) ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET customer = excluded.customer, cents = excluded.cents, status = excluded.status, note = excluded.note

capabilities.input: Record {id: Int, customer: String, cents: Int, status: String, note: Option<String>}
capabilities.description: Inserts an order, or replaces the order with the same id.

sqlite.statement: SELECT status, count(*) AS n, sum(cents) AS cents FROM orders GROUP BY status ORDER BY status

capabilities.output: List<Record {status: String, n: Int, cents: Int}>
capabilities.description: Counts the orders and totals their cents for each status.
